title: Guest's statistical analysis of Ganzfeld telepathy trials

tellings.quote:
the hit
rate across the best trials or at least
the best quality studies seems to be
around 30 to 35%.

plain: A guest on a 2026 podcast, speaking as a researcher, describes the Ganzfeld trials, telepathy experiments begun in the 1970s in which a person in mild sensory isolation tries to pick out an image someone else is looking at, work associated with a researcher named Charles Honorton. The guest says that across the best quality studies the hit rate seems to be around 30 to 35 percent. If that holds up, it would suggest people can pick up information beyond chance, which would point to some kind of mind-to-mind connection.
